description: Finds why a circuit someone built does not work. Use this when the person says "why won't my LED light?", "my 555 does not blink", "the motor does not turn" or "I built this and nothing happens". Takes the symptom and either the circuit or a description of what was built, which it draws as built. Simulates that and a proposed fix, and says if the simulator confirms the fix or the circuit as drawn works (so the fault is on the board). Returns the likely causes, its reading of a described circuit, live links to both circuits, checks to make on the board and the readings a working circuit gives. Takes up to 3 minutes. Counts toward the daily design limit.

circuit.description: The circuit: CircuitJS (falstad.com/circuit) text, a "$" options line then one part per line such as "r 176 112 304 112 0 220" for a 220 ohm resistor (at most 20,000 characters), or a breadboardhub.com/sim link that carries one.

description.description: What was built, drawn as built with any mistakes: the parts, their values and what connects to what, including which way round parts are, such as "9V battery + to a 470 ohm resistor, then the LED long leg, short leg to battery -" (up to 3,000 characters). Needed when no circuit is given.

symptom.description: What goes wrong, what was expected, and anything measured, such as "the LED does not light; the battery reads 9V" (3 to 1,000 characters).

name: debug_circuit
title: Debug a real circuit
